evidence.note: Charcoal serif title and grey subtitle on white; soft blurred blue blobs in the background, pale and diffuse rather than glaring.
Grey, blue and deep red arrows as strokes on white cards; blue check badges as fills; the red 'Misaligned reinforcement:' label is dark red text on white, no bright-on-bright.
Light grey server panel with blue outlined agent dots and grey lines; small red alert dot and red lock badge used as fills only.
Blue, black and red dots plus blue strokes on a grey panel; the legend matches; red confined to small marker fills.
Three white cards with charcoal text, grey body copy and small blue bullets; blue used only for the kicker, nav and progress bar.
Charcoal 'Thank you' on white with the same soft blue blobs as the title slide; consistent with the title.

rationale: Across the deck the palette is charcoal and grey on white with a single blue accent and a sparing deep red for warnings. The bright colours appear only as strokes, marker fills, badges and soft background washes, never as bright text on a bright fill. Nothing clashes or glares, which matches the pass descriptor and the reference anchor.
